text.en:
For a period of three (3) calendar year beginning January 1, 1978 up to December 31, 1980, the
internal revenue allotment shares of each province, city or municipality shall be determined pursuant to the
pertinent provisions of Presidential Decree No. 144, as amended by Presidential Decree No. 937, and as read
in relation with the provisions of Presidential Decrees Nos. 559 and 898.

Thereafter, or beginning January 1, 1981, the Annual Allotment shares of the local governments
shall be determined on the basis of Sections 1, 2 and 3 of Presidential Decree No. 144, as amended by
Presidential Decree Nos. 559 and 898.

The Secretary of Finance shall issue the rules and regulations necessary for the proper
implementation of this Decree.

All laws, decrees, orders, and rules and regulations or parts thereof, which are contrary to or
inconsistent with this Decree, are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.

This Decree, except as otherwise provided for herein, shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 14th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
